Exercise 7. 1. Mīna · proposes a coffee tomorrow night, before leaving Sunday morning · tomorrow evening · you must call it back. 2. Yāsmīn · the mother will prepare the maḥši for the arrival of Luke, therefore he must not eat by plane · on the day of arrival · no answer needed (just a thank you). 3. Šarīf · you will not be able to go to the airport 3 because he has a commitment with his uncle, he will go there Yāsmīn · on 3 July · none (don't worry). Exercise 8. a) To invite him to a greeting dinner for MīnaFriday night. Two months. Mulūḫiyya And chicken, with the help of the mother on video. Sweets. 'Cause he finishes work at 7:30. b) The 3 July at 5 p.m. He'll wait for him at the airport and take him straight to his mother's for lunch. 'Cause five o'clock seems late for lunch. Šarīf explains that in Egypt, lunch is late. Work a little in Uncle's firm and go to Alexandria for a week. To go with them; because Luke has a lesson every day, they will go on the weekend.
